jobs.draft:
What excites you most with software development?
What excites me most is turning real problems into products people use. I enjoy working across interfaces, APIs and integrations, then seeing those pieces come together in a useful product. At Tututor.ai / EduNova, that has meant building education workflows for teachers, students and families. I also enjoy learning tools that help me deliver a better result.

Why?
AI can write better code than humans and handle repetitive work, but I don't believe it will replace software developers. It cannot replace the human understanding of business logic and people's needs, or the responsibility for deciding what to build and which system-design trade-offs to make. I see AI as a powerful tool for developers, while people remain responsible for the product and its decisions.

Describe a software project you are proud of
One project I'm proud of is Tututor.ai / EduNova, a suite of eight connected education products used by 20,000+ students, teachers and families. It brings together web and mobile workflows, including lesson-topic chatbots, AI quiz generation, automated grading and class insights. The wider platform includes real-time messaging, file storage and billing, along with three React Native apps released on both app stores.

Describe your role in that project
I am the Lead Engineer / Full-Stack Engineer. I build and maintain the shared Express and MongoDB backend, which has approximately 1,000 API endpoints and 90 models, and deliver features across the web, mobile and AI workflows. I moved AI calls and API keys server-side. I led a small team across web and mobile delivery and now work directly with the founder on product and engineering.

Role Title: Software Engineer — Open Source Contributions

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

Develop, implement, and refine new features within existing open source codebases using Python3, Java, Rust, C++, and Typescript.

Analyze and resolve complex bugs, ensuring robust and maintainable solutions that align with project standards.

Refactor and optimize legacy code to enhance performance, readability, and scalability.

Contribute to code validation processes, focusing on accuracy, output consistency, and best coding practices.

Utilize advanced algorithms and competitive programming techniques to conceptualize and deliver efficient solutions for intricate problems.

Collaborate remotely with other contributors to review proposed changes and maintain project documentation.

Deliver clear, concise technical write-ups to articulate solution design and implementation details.

Preferred Qualifications

Expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following: Python, C++, Java, Rust, Typescript, Go, or C#.

Extensive experience in open source contributions, particularly in feature development, bug fixing, and codebase refactoring.

Demonstrated expertise in competitive programming and complex coding problem analysis.

Strong analytical skills to interpret multifaceted problem constraints and identify multiple solution pathways.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for clear, precise technical documentation and peer collaboration.

Meticulous attention to detail in code review, validation, and maintenance.

Comfort working independently in a remote, collaborative environment with a commitment to producing high-quality, well-documented code under project deadlines.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Volunteer AI Full Stack Engineer (AI-Native / Rapid Development)

About this Role

Position type: Volunteer (unpaid), pro bono

Location: Remote / International

Time commitment: 10–15 hours per week for a minimum of 3 months

Experience level: 2–5 years

Professional Volunteering: Professional volunteering at Solution Community is a skills-based service performed with the same reliability, accountability, and quality expected in a paid professional role. Volunteers are core contributors whose work directly supports our mission of global compassion, collaboration, and action.

About Solution Community: Solution Community is an international 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, pioneering an innovative social platform dedicated to enabling actionable change. With volunteers from over 70 countries, we are a testament to the power of global collaboration. Our team members bring experience from some of the world's most successful companies, including Apple, Toyota, Google, Netflix, Walmart, Meta, and many others.

Our Mission: To foster a global community of compassion, uniting individuals and organizations to solve the world's social problems. We are the bridge that connects non-profits, businesses, philanthropists, and volunteers, empowering them to create meaningful change.

Our Vision: A world united by collaboration, compassion, and action — where every person can thrive. At Solution Community, we are turning that vision into reality.

Position Overview: We are seeking a Volunteer AI Full Stack Engineer who builds production software the way top AI-native engineers build in 2026: primarily through AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent), not the classical write-every-line, sprint-by-sprint engineering lifecycle.

This is a vibe-coding role in the best sense — you move at the speed of AI-assisted development, but you bring the engineering judgment to keep quality high. Most "vibe coders" ship fast and buggy; we need someone who ships fast and correct. You'll design, generate, review, debug, and deploy real features for our platform, working directly with our CEO (who builds the same way) and our engineering team.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Accelerated Development

Build and ship full features — front end, back end, integrations — primarily by directing AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.), not manual line-by-line coding.

Rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy working software in days, not sprints.

Apply strong engineering judgment to review, debug, and harden AI-generated code — catching the bugs, security gaps, and architectural mistakes that typical vibe-coded output has.

Design clear, specific prompts and technical specs that get AI tools to production-quality output on the first or second pass.

Full Stack Ownership

Develop and maintain responsive web applications, APIs, databases, and cloud services end to end.

Own your features from spec through deployment — no separate QA/handoff cycle to lean on.

Ensure application security, performance, and reliability despite the compressed build timeline.

Collaboration & Support

Work directly with the CEO and engineering lead on architecture and priorities — minimal process overhead.

Document what you build clearly enough that another AI-native engineer (human or agent) can pick it up without you.

Mentor other volunteers on AI-assisted development practices.

What We Are Looking For

Required

Advanced, daily, hands-on proficiency with Claude Code, Codex, or an equivalent AI coding agent — able to architect, generate, debug, and ship full applications with AI as the primary development method, not an autocomplete assistant.

Solid full-stack fundamentals (front end: React, Vue, or similar; back end: Node.js, Python, or similar) — enough to review, debug, and correct AI-generated code, not necessarily to write everything by hand.

Experience with RESTful APIs and SQL and/or NoSQL databases.

Familiarity with a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

A track record of shipping working software fast, with the discipline to test and verify it before calling it done.

Preferred

Experience with LLM/AI application development (OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering).

Docker, Kubernetes, or other cloud-native deployment experience.

Prior volunteer, nonprofit, or social-impact work.

Skills

Strong problem-solving and independent judgment — you catch what the AI gets wrong.

Clear written communication (specs, docs, async updates).

Comfortable operating with high autonomy and minimal process.

Genuine interest in AI-native development and technology-driven social impact.

Application requirement

Include 2–3 examples of production apps or features you built primarily using an AI coding agent, with rough build time for each. This is the main filter — general dev experience without demonstrated AI-native speed will not be a fit for this role.

What Success Looks Like

Features shipped in days, not weeks, with bug rates comparable to (or better than) traditionally coded work.

Code and architecture that the rest of the team can read, extend, and trust without a rewrite.

Reliable, secure, working software in production — not demos.

Growing autonomy: less spec detail needed from the CEO/lead over time as trust is established.

What We Offer

Global collaboration with leaders and strategists from top global companies.

Meaningful impact on global causes and communities.

A vibrant, multicultural team spanning 70+ countries.

A supportive environment rooted in compassion, integrity, innovation, and collaboration.

Flexible work with full autonomy.

Opportunities for personal and professional growth.

About Cority Cority helps customers see and prevent risks across their operations in real time. Our EHS+ platform converges people, data, and AI agents to provide a clear view of information people can trust, automate workflows that make people more impactful, and deliver personalized insights and expertise to improve decision-making. While most solutions respond to risks one at a time, Cority helps prevent them across environmental management, employee health, safety, quality, and sustainability. For 40 years, Cority has been the market leader in EHS+, recognized by top analysts and trusted by more than 1,500 of the most complex organizations worldwide. Cority has received many awards for its strong employee culture and outstanding business performance. To learn more, visit www.cority.com.

Cority is looking for a Software Engineer to be a part of our existing team. Our organization is a dynamic, fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. We are looking for a passionate team player who is committed to the success of the collective group. The successful candidate will be able to leverage their excellent technical capabilities and drive while delivering immediate value and influencing our long-term roadmap. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a highly skilled and dynamic team. We take the success of our customers incredibly seriously and our team is a critical part of this success.

Reporting to the Development Manager, the Software Engineer is primarily responsible for designing and enhancing base Cority software, as well as working with Product Development to develop software to meet client needs.

Responsibilities:

Drive technical and architectural decisions to meet product requirements while also anticipating and designing for future needs.

Lead teams technically to drive production ready code.

Design and develop new software and enhance existing software for clients’ systems, and for Cority’s base software.

Communicate directly with Product Owners to ensure that requirements and specifications are understood.

Develop high-quality software and is an advocate of automation frameworks for testing, integration, and deployment.

Review completed software designs or prototypes with team and participates in code reviews

Tracks sprint work and provides proper transparency/visibility to their team

Provide support and maintenance.

Own one or more functional area’s or projects and help breakdown task into manageable stories.

Mentor junior developers.

Open to learning and working with modern technologies as required in the project.

Qualifications:

Must have a university degree in computer science or a related program.

4+ years of experience as a developer.

Strong understanding of software development process & lifecycle.

Experience with Agile & Scrum methodology.

Technical Qualifications:

Must Have -

Experience with using AI for development including tools like Github Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.

Experience with .NET Core, .Net Framework, Entity Framework/Dapper, Web APIs and Microservices.

Experience developing of database applications using relational database systems such as Postgres, SQL Server.

Experience with Node, Angular/React, HTML5, CSS, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python.

Experience with CI and CD.

Nice to Have -

Experience with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks, RAG, Vector DB’s & MCP servers.

Experience with NoSQL databases like MongoDB.

Experience with AWS or Azure.

Experience with Multi-tenancy.

Experience with Message Queues like SQS, Google Queues, RabbitMQ, Kafka.

Experience with Docker.

Soft Skills:

Proven passion for technology and can navigate your way across complex and rapidly changing landscapes by staying on top of the latest trends.

A self-starter who actively challenges the status-quo, is curious and not afraid to ask “why” and “what”.

Fantastic communications (written and oral), who thrives on sharing and gaining knowledge.

Experience working with remote teams.

Previous experience in the field of occupational health, environment, ergonomics or safety is an asset.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

An opportunity to work in a values-driven, performance oriented, dynamic and growth focused culture

We support a remote working environment with a one-time home office allowance and subsidized monthly internet allowance

Competitive health benefits, dental plans, and retirement savings plan (RRSP, 401K plan etc.)

Annual fitness allowance

Mental health support provided through access to Calm Premium meditation app and access to Talkspace

Access to learning tools & platforms, internal training programs, annual training allowance and certifications (if applicable), and High Talent Programs

Cority is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. Cority is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, age, disability or any other legally protected status. For applicants who would like to request for accommodation please send an email to .

Source: Himalayas
Original listing: https://himalayas.app/companies/spotter-labs/jobs/remote-fullstack-engineer-react-django-ai-systems-8589740143

We're a remote, product-focused startup building AI- and algorithm-driven systems. We're
looking for a FullStack Engineer who can move fluidly between React frontends and Django

backends.

You'll own features end-to-end: from designing the data model, building the API, to crafting the
UI that brings it all together. You'll work with a small distributed team across several countries,
shipping fast and iterating based on real feedback.

💰 $100 bonus: After successfully completing the assessment. To receive the assessment,
please submit your resume to this job application. If your resume is approved, you'll receive the

assessment afterwards.

What You'll Do

Build and ship complete features across React frontend and Django backend.

Develop responsive web apps using React and Material UI (MUI).

Design backend services and APIs using Python + Django (DRF or similar).

Create clean, responsive UIs with React that connect to our services.

Implement algorithmic/AI logic (scoring, ranking, decision rules) and surface it in the UI.

Write pragmatic, production-ready code that ships fast and iterates easily.

What We're Looking For

Strong proficiency in React and Material UI.

Attention to detail: You care about alignment, spacing, and how the app feels to the user.

Comfortable designing and building RESTful APIs (bonus if you’ve used DRF or similar frameworks).

Experience working on non-trivial business logic or algorithms (e.g., decision flows, scoring rules, optimization logic).

Good instincts around performance: understanding query behavior, avoiding obvious pitfalls, and using caching when it counts.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate clearly.

Bonus Points For

Comfortable coding with AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.).

Experience shipping complete products in startups, side projects, or hackathons.

Background in algorithms or data-heavy systems.

Experience with GCP, Redis, or Docker/Kubernetes.

Familiarity shipping mobile apps with React Native.

This role is a central piece of our product roadmap, and we're aiming to fill it quickly once we
meet the right person. If it resonates with you, go ahead and apply now. Send us your resume
to start the assessment process (and get a chance at the $100 bonus).

Who We Are

Holiday Channel is a forward-thinking startup focused on creating innovative solutions like Digital Magazines, Marketplace and Streaming Platform to enhance holiday experiences. Holiday World is a digital media and entertainment company building the world’s first platform for ALL THINGS HOLIDAY where consumers can conveniently find all their holiday needs 24x7x365 — entertainment, shopping, trends, traditions, food, travel, DIY, and the best deals. We created Holiday World to inspire, celebrate, and unite people through holidays, as well as all the traditions and rituals that accompany them. As the first inclusive destination devoted to sharing a global lens on holiday celebrations and preparation, Holiday World is a catalyst for more diverse storytelling and cross-cultural education. Our mission is to give millions of people a reason to celebrate and savor every day, every moment, all year by uniting communities with more joy, more fun, and more compassion. Holiday World is a for-profit company that holds its social mission at its core.

What We Offer

Immediate opportunity to make an impact on our team, product, and business.

A chance to work with a startup that has over 110K users.

A get-stuff-done and fun and caring culture.

Meaningful work and a strong shared sense of mission.

A remote first working environment with an office in Colorado Springs, CO.

A platform to lead and innovate within a dynamic startup environment, offering substantial opportunities for professional growth and development.

Sponsorship for international students on F-1 OPT ((Optional Practical Training)

What This Role Is

We are seeking talented and motivated individuals to join our team for an exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies and projects. This unpaid internship is designed for software engineers who are passionate about web development and want to enhance their skills in full-stack development, with a focus on TypeScript, Next.js, React.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and microservice architecture. As a Software Engineer Intern (MERN Stack with TypeScript), you will work alongside experienced developers, contribute to real-world projects, and gain invaluable experience in full-stack web development. You’ll be involved in all stages of the development process, from concept to deployment, and will have the opportunity to sharpen your skills while building meaningful applications.

What You'll Do

Collaborate with the development team to design, build, and maintain full-stack web applications using Next.js/React.js, Node.js and Express.js with TypeScript.

Implement responsive user interfaces using Tailwind CSS.

Create engaging animations and interactions with Framer Motion.

Develop and manage PostgreSQL databases.

Assist in integrating APIs and third-party services.

Participate in code reviews and contribute to team discussions on best practices. Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems.

Stay updated with the latest web technologies and tools.

Work on both front-end and back-end features of the application.

Contribute to the planning and design of new software products.

What You'll Have

2+ years of experience working with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js).

Proficiency in TypeScript.

Strong understanding of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

Experience with front-end frameworks (Next.js, React.js) and back-end frameworks (Node.js, Express.js).

Familiarity with Tailwind CSS for responsive design.

Experience with Framer Motion for animations.

Knowledge of PostgreSQL and database management.

Understanding of microservice architecture.

Familiarity with RESTful APIs and version control systems (Git).

Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Strong communication skills and the ability to contribute ideas in a constructive manner.

Experience in eCommerce development is a plus.

What Helps You Stand Out

Familiarity with cloud services such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines.

About Chasi

Work on real-world challenges in the industrial AI and commerce space.

Learn from engineers building AI-first B2B platforms from the ground up.

Build features that ship fast, matter deeply, and scale meaningfully.

Demonstrated success in identifying and resolving software bugs and system bottlenecks.

Experience with codebase refactoring and implementing complex features in large-scale applications.

Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and foundational computer science concepts.

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

Compensation Structure:

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability:

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

About The Agile Monkeys

The Agile Monkeys is a software boutique with over 75 people and we keep growing.We do two things:

We create products: We are a very creative team that is constantly pursuing new ideas and projects we love. Now we are focused on building products related to search and AI. We take great joy in tackling the challenges of AI associated with scalability and information retrieval.

We deliver bespoke consulting solutions to leading enterprises, driving strategic transformation, operational excellence, and sustainable growth

About the position:

The project: You will be working with one of the most renowned entities in the insurance field. You’ll have the opportunity to engage with a competitive community of engineers to craft complex solutions and have an impact in the company’s success. Some of the tasks you can expect to do are:

Participate in architecture and software development discussions and decisions.

Translate functional requirements into technical requirements together with the other team members.

Refactor legacy code, improving it by applying good coding practices.

Collaborate with the QA team to ensure everything works well before releasing the code to production.

Participate in agile ceremonies.

Duration: Initially, the position is for 6 months, but it can be extended depending on the client's needs.

Dedication: It’s a full-time position (8 hours, 5 days a week) and fully remote (preferably if you are in a time zone ranging from GMT -7 to GMT +2).

Schedule: At our company, we understand that everyone has unique schedules and needs. Therefore, we offer flexibility in terms of working hours, and will only ask you to make sure you have overlapping time to attend client and team meetings.

The Agile Monkeys way: You will be part of our team and, therefore, will take advantage of all of our perks: technical workshops and presentations, mentoring, and coaching sessions, among others.

About the Role

At The Agile Monkeys, we’re looking for a Senior React Developer who’s ready to go beyond coding and step up as a team lead. This role is ideal for someone who not only has deep React expertise but also loves mentoring others, coordinating teams, and ensuring project success.

You’ll be leading two squads of junior/intermediate developers, helping them grow while keeping delivery on track. You’ll also collaborate with backend, infrastructure, and automation teams to ensure smooth integration of features and handle complex requirements.

What is required in terms of APTITUDE:

At least 8 years of experience working as a software engineer.

Strong expertise in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.

Solid experience with HTML, CSS, and frontend best practices.

Experience leading or mentoring junior and intermediate developers.

Ability to understand complex requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Proven track record of delivering features in coordination with multiple teams (backend, infra, automation).

Knowledge of testing practices and promoting clean, maintainable code.

Considered a Plus:

Backend experience: Java, Spring, Struts 1, JSP, Maven, PostgreSQL.

Infrastructure/automation knowledge: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Azure.

Previous experience as a team lead or technical coordinator.

What is required in terms of COMMUNICATION:

English level: B2 or higher – written, spoken, and listening (international team, cross-team collaboration required).

Strong communication skills: ability to discuss technical challenges, create and review proposals, and raise issues early to ensure smooth project delivery.

Comfortable coordinating with multiple teams and aligning stakeholders.

What is required in terms of ATTITUDE:

Proactivity: willing to take ownership, suggest improvements, and step up to guide the team.

Humility: open to feedback and eager to collaborate in order to grow and help others grow.

Flexibility: while React is the core, openness to contribute in backend or infrastructure areas when needed.

Teamwork: able to foster collaboration, mentor juniors, and build bridges between teams.

Ubaidullah Omer

jobs.description:
Company Description

Wise AI is a Harvard-MIT-founded, VC-backed start-up focused on revolutionizing health monitoring through innovative technology. The company is developing a population-scale health monitoring solution that is accessible to anyone with a smartphone.

Our core offering is a health sensing platform that measures vital signs (heart rate, HRV, stress indicators, and more) using remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) — directly from a standard camera, without any wearables or additional hardware.

At Wise AI, we aim to empower individuals worldwide by making health tracking seamless, efficient, and universally available. Join us in creating cutting-edge solutions that have the potential to transform healthcare accessibility.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Founding Engineer in Fullstack Development, with a focus on ZoomApp integration. The Founding Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable software systems, building both front-end and back-end components, and integrating third-party platforms such as Zoom. Responsibilities include collaborating with cross-functional teams, ensuring optimal system performance, and contributing to a fast-paced start-up environment with innovation and problem-solving.

Qualifications

Proficiency in fullstack development and expertise in modern programming languages/frameworks (e.g., Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js)

Experience with ZoomApps (must-have)

Experience with API development

Strong skills in system design, database management, and performance optimization

Ability to build and maintain scalable, user-friendly, and responsive web applications

Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and DevOps practices

Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to adapt in a start-up environment

Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams

Prior experience in health-tech or a related field is a plus

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

Tech Stack (Flexible but Current Direction)

Frontend: React / TypeScript / Zoom Apps SDK

Backend: Python (FastAPI) / Node.js

Vision / ML: OpenCV, MediaPipe, PyTorch / TensorFlow

Signal Processing: SciPy, NumPy

Hosting: AWS / GCP

Version Control: GitHub

Design/Docs: Figma / Notion

You will influence and evolve this stack.

Why This Is Different

This is not just another engineering job.

You will be:

One of the first technical hires

A core part of product, research, and vision

Solving a truly hard, meaningful problem at the intersection of: Healthcare, AI, Computer Vision

Eligible for significant equity

Building a product that can help millions, including caregivers, clinicians, and the elderly

If you want your code to actually matter — this is it.

Who This Role Is Perfect For

This is a great fit if you are:

A builder who wants to work on something deeply technical + highly human

A grad / PhD / engineer who has worked on CV or signals and wants real-world impact

A high-potential engineer tired of big-company bureaucracy

Someone excited by the idea: “What if Zoom could check your vitals?”

How to Apply

Email or message with:

A short intro

GitHub / portfolio / papers (if any)

1–2 projects (involving a ZoomApp) you're most proud of.

Contact:

Originally posted on Himalayas

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 1,800 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City (opening Summer 2026), you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team: 

Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale. Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer-facing experience.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. Working primarily in React and TypeScript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile-web and full-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. You'll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to turn ambiguous problems into durable, well-architected solutions, and you'll mentor other engineers along the way.

 

How you’ll make an impact

Own the design and delivery of large, complex frontend and full-stack initiatives using React and TypeScript, from planning and sequencing through launch and long-term maintenance.

Set technical direction for the team's frontend architecture and full-stack patterns, owning a 3–6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten team effectiveness.

Partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high-quality experiences.

Raise the bar for engineering excellence through strong component and API design, thoughtful state management, testing, observability, and operational rigor across borrower-facing surfaces.

Lead through ambiguity, breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs on scope, performance, and user experience.

Mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team.

Contribute to how the team uses AI in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage.

 

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Deep proficiency building complex web applications with React and TypeScript, including component architecture, state management, performance optimization, and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs.

Full-stack experience designing and building backend services and APIs in a language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, or Node.js.

Track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business-critical frontend or full-stack projects in production.

Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product, design, and engineering partners.

 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience serving as the frontend or full-stack technical lead for a product team or business-critical product surface.

Experience building consumer-facing products at scale with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and user experience.

Background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products with complex user journeys and high quality expectations.

Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flagging to drive iterative product improvements in production.

Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress) and CI/CD workflows.

Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI in product features or internal engineering workflows.

Passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers.

 

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

 

#LI-REMOTE

#LI-MidSenior --> use for L5, L6

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

$166,900—$223,900 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly 

Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)

Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)

Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.

Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)

Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security

Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements

Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)

Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs

Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources

Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)

Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you

Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from

Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)

Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City (opening Summer 2026!)

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate_accommodations@upstart.com

About the Job

The Opportunity

As a Junior Software Engineer at Emetlab, you will contribute to building the technology infrastructure behind elite AI training data that powers frontier models worldwide. Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company delivering expert-produced, rigorously validated datasets and end-to-end AI solutions to laboratories, Fortune 500 enterprises, ambitious startups, and sovereign AI programmes across the globe.

In this role, you will work alongside senior engineers to develop, test, and ship features across our data platform, contributor tools, and client-facing systems. You will gain hands-on experience with large-scale data pipelines, quality assurance automation, and the infrastructure that enables over 5,000 domain experts across 120+ countries to produce world-class training data. You will be trusted with meaningful work from day one, not sidelined with tasks that don't matter.

This is a rare opportunity to begin your engineering career at the intersection of AI and data infrastructure, where your contributions will be visible, valued, and directly tied to the quality of datasets that train the next generation of intelligent systems.

What You'll Do

Write clean, well-tested code that contributes to Emetlab's core platform, data pipelines, and internal tooling. Collaborate with senior engineers on the design and implementation of new features across our contributor platform, quality assurance systems, and client delivery infrastructure. Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving feedback that elevates the quality of the entire team's work. Assist in debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving issues across the platform with attention to detail and persistence. Contribute to building and improving automation that supports our multi-stage quality assurance processes and 98%+ accuracy benchmarks. Learn and grow rapidly by engaging with modern tools, frameworks, and AI-adjacent technologies in a production environment.

What You'll Need to Succeed

A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience through bootcamps, self-directed learning, or personal projects. Foundational knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript. Familiarity with web development fundamentals including APIs, databases, and version control with Git. A genuine desire to learn, improve, and take ownership of your growth as an engineer. Strong communication skills and a collaborative disposition, comfortable working within a team and asking thoughtful questions. Genuine interest in AI, data systems, or machine learning infrastructure is highly valued.

Role Details

Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Growth stage, operational

About Emetlab

Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company built on a single conviction: the quality ceiling of any AI system is determined by its training data, not its architecture or compute. We produce expert-crafted, rigorously validated training datasets across 12 specialised domains, delivered by a global network of over 5,000 vetted domain specialists spanning 100+ languages and 50+ specialisations. Beyond datasets, we offer end-to-end AI solutions including Fine-Tuning, RLHF & Alignment, Red Teaming, Model Evaluation, Data Annotation, Synthetic Data Generation, and Pre-Training Data Pipelines.

We are not a crowd-sourcing platform. We are the data partner that matches the ambition of the teams building the next generation of AI, delivering measurable results: 42% accuracy improvements, 3x faster time-to-production, and 99.4% regulatory precision.

Equal Opportunity

Emetlab is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that extraordinary products are built by extraordinary teams, and extraordinary teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin.

If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to our team and we will ensure your needs are met with care.

Let's build the future of AI training data, together.

About the Job

The Opportunity

As a Senior Software Engineer at Mimi Dental Clinic, you will design and build the digital systems that power Ibadan's premier dental practice, serving over 15,000 patients with world-class care across more than two decades of continuous operation. Mimi Dental Clinic is a leading dental healthcare provider delivering exceptional, patient-centred care with warmth, precision, and integrity, backed by nearly 2,000 Google reviews and a 4.9-star rating.

In this role, you will take ownership of critical technology systems, from our patient-facing mobile application and online booking platform to electronic health records, clinic operations infrastructure, and data-driven patient engagement tools. You will lead technical initiatives, make architectural decisions that directly improve patient outcomes and operational efficiency, and ensure that our digital experience reflects the same standard of excellence our patients have trusted for over 20 years.

This is an opportunity to do meaningful engineering work at the intersection of healthcare and technology, where the systems you build will shape how thousands of patients access, experience, and benefit from premium dental care.

What You'll Do

Design, build, and maintain scalable applications, APIs, and services that power Mimi Dental Clinic's patient-facing platforms and internal clinical operations. Develop and optimise our mobile application and web-based booking systems to deliver a seamless, refined patient experience from appointment scheduling through post-treatment follow-up. Own features and systems end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through to testing, deployment, and monitoring. Lead architectural decisions that ensure platform reliability, security, and compliance with healthcare data protection standards as our patient base and service offerings grow. Architect and maintain integrations between clinical systems, patient management tools, and third-party healthcare platforms. Implement robust data security practices that protect sensitive patient health information and maintain the trust our community has placed in us. Collaborate cross-functionally with clinical, operations, and patient experience teams to deliver technology that enhances the quality and accessibility of our care. Contribute to infrastructure and DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployment, and system monitoring to ensure continuous uptime and performance.

What You'll Need to Succeed

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in one or more languages such as Python, C#, Java, TypeScript, or Go. Proven experience designing and building production-grade APIs, mobile applications, and services that operate reliably at scale. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern deployment practices. Experience working with databases (relational and/or NoSQL), caching layers, and data management systems, with particular attention to data integrity and security. A strong engineering mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity, making pragmatic trade-offs, and delivering with quality under pace. Understanding of healthcare data privacy principles and secure software development practices is highly valued. A collaborative disposition, comfortable working cross-functionally with clinical staff, operations, and product teams in an environment where technology serves patient care. Genuine interest in healthcare technology, patient experience systems, or digital health innovation is highly valued.

Role Details

Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Established, 20+ years operational

About Mimi Dental Clinic

Mimi Dental Clinic is Ibadan's premier dental practice, founded in 2004 with a singular vision: to deliver world-class dental care with warmth, precision, and integrity. For over two decades, we have been the trusted choice for individuals and families seeking exceptional oral healthcare in a refined, comfortable setting. We provide a comprehensive suite of dental services including general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics, dental implants, oral surgery, paediatric dentistry, and emergency care.

We are not simply a dental clinic. We are the standard that others aspire to, serving over 15,000 satisfied patients with a 99% satisfaction rate, investing continuously in advanced technology, and building digital experiences that reflect the same commitment to excellence that defines every aspect of our care.

Equal Opportunity

Mimi Dental Clinic is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that exceptional care is delivered by exceptional teams, and exceptional teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin.

If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to our team and we will ensure your needs are met with care.

Let's build the future of dental healthcare, together.

Application Development: Architect, develop, and maintain full stack applications that deliver measurable business value.

Collaboration: Partner with product managers, UX designers, and engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions.

Code Quality: Deliver clean, efficient, and testable code following best practices in scalability, performance, and maintainability.

Cloud & Infrastructure: Leverage modern cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) to design secure and resilient applications.

Lifecycle Management: Contribute to all phases of the software development lifecycle, including architecture design, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Standards & Compliance: Ensure applications align with security, data privacy, and regulatory requirements.

Innovation: Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend improvements to enhance system architecture and team productivity.

Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in front-end frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue).

Proven expertise in back-end frameworks (Node.js, Python, Express, or equivalent).

Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and non-relational databases (SQL and NoSQL).

Strong understanding of API design, micro services architecture, and cloud platforms.

Track record of delivering projects in distributed or remote environments.

Exceptional problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field preferred.

Role Details

Remote position, aligned to EST hours (9 AM – 6 PM, Monday through Friday).

Competitive compensation with opportunities for career advancement.

Collaborative, growth-oriented environment with exposure to diverse projects.

We are looking for a developer who combines technical expertise with business acumen and is motivated to deliver solutions that scale, perform, and create impact.

CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market-leading industry expertise, and world-class customer satisfaction.

Key Accountabilities:

Help shape technical direction on the Essentials squad — contributing to architecture decisions and unblocking teammates — while staying hands-on in Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, and React

Lead by example in the codebase: write clean, maintainable, refactor-friendly code and elevate quality through thoughtful code review and pairing

Design and optimize back-end systems, APIs, and data flows with a strong focus on performance and reliability, sharing what you learn along the way

Build modern, responsive front-end experiences using React, TypeScript, and CSS, with an eye toward maintainable architecture

Work across relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, etc.), writing efficient SQL and shaping data models that support business growth

Lead projects end-to-end, balancing hands-on development with guiding others to successful delivery, surfacing risks early and communicating trade-offs clearly

Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and QA to translate business needs into sound technical solutions

Embrace AI-assisted engineering: use tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot effectively, contribute to shared prompts and agentic workflows, and help the team learn what works

Identify and prototype opportunities to apply LLMs and automation to engineering and internal workflows, with the guardrails appropriate to healthcare data and regulated billing

Desired Skills and Experience:

At least 7-10 years of full-stack development experience, with Ruby on Rails as a core strength

Experience with React, 5+ years preferred.

Experienced in leading projects end-to-end: from breaking down complex problems to shipping features that drive impact

Passionate about mentoring, from pair programming to guiding architectural decisions, and helping others grow as engineers

Daily, hands-on fluency with AI development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), with sharp judgment about where AI accelerates work and where human review is non-negotiable

Experience, or strong demonstrated interest, in building with LLM APIs: prompt design, evaluation, and safety considerations for sensitive data

Highly organized with superb attention to detail

Strong project management skills: comfortable with planning, estimation, and scoping

Proven ability to work in an ever-changing environment, ability to connect the dots and make decisions on your own feet

Ability to produce quality materials within tight timeframes and simultaneously manage several projects

Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, verbally and in writing

Exercise sound judgment and work successfully with all employee levels, regardless of background and perspectives

Be comfortable working in a distributed, semi-virtual environment

Be capable of creating and executing on technical direction and tasks for yourself and others

Be able to take minimal direction from others and provide maximal output for yourself (and others)

Base Salary Range

$120,000—$180,000 USD

Backed by Roper Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: ROP), CentralReach is entering an exciting phase of growth, innovation, and scale.

Recognized as one of the best places to work over 10 times by organizations such as Inc, Built In, and NJBIZ, our culture is centered around impact, inclusion, and flexibility. As a hybrid company with collaborative offices in Ft. Lauderdale, FL; Holmdel, NJ; and Verona, Italy, we foster a workplace where top talent can thrive and make a real difference in the lives of those we serve.

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits, generous PTO, 401(k) matching, and paid parental leave to our full-time employees. Our team members also enjoy hybrid work schedules, career development support, wellness programs, and opportunities to give back through CR Cares™, our community engagement initiative.

Be part of a market leader driving the future of care. Explore opportunities at centralreach.com/careers.

Protecting your information is important to us. Please take a moment to review our Notice of Privacy Practices for Job Applicants. Applicant-Privacy-Notice-110725 to understand how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information during the recruitment process.

Software Engineer, Data Integration

In Brief

We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.

Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved.

What you’ll do

You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform to generate real-time lifesaving clinical insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' technical teams, you'll turn fragmented data into immediate, actionable clinical insights that empower care teams to make the best decisions for their patients.

Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a lab result isn't reaching the Bayesian platform for a patient, you have thirty minutes and the client's full attention to trace it from the inbound HL7 message through parsing, mapping, and ingestion, and tell them what happened.

Responsibilities

Data Integration & Ingestion: Partner with the client's technical teams to design and implement the data integration interface and ingestion pipelines that feed the Bayesian platform with real-time clinical data, powering insights that improve patient outcomes.

Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests at the data layer, and work directly with client technical teams during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations.

Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring build and configuration for the data interface, ingestion, and mapping are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any data integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication.

Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the data integration workstream with the overall integration effort.

Minimum qualifications

BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

3+ years building and deploying data pipelines to production, including integration with external APIs (Python preferred)

Strong ability to investigate and resolve data correctness problem end-to-end, across services, storage, and external data sources.

Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment

Experience writing automated integration tests for production systems

Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Project/Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results.

Preferred qualifications

Experience with health data, integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, and Health IT interoperability standards such as HL7v2 and FHIR.

Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues

Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require.

Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity

Bayesian Health provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Backend leaning Software Engineer. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, high-performance systems. Leveraging JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, SQL and NoSQL cloud-native databases, and AWS, you will develop innovative solutions for user, group, and membership management while ensuring the highest levels of security and reliability.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

Enable us to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable services that exceed industry standards and customer expectations.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale projects with cross-team dependencies.

Collaborate with peer teams to deliver solutions that meet industry standards and customer expectations.

Maintain and operate services at high scale, participating in scheduled on-call rotations to ensure reliability.

Implement identity synchronization and lifecycle management solutions using SCIM and other relevant standards.

Work with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes, etc.) to deliver scalable, high-availability applications.

Build and maintain high-quality enterprise software using TypeScript, REST APIs, and JSON.

About You:

Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, React, and Node.js.

Strong knowledge of security architecture, LDAP, Active Directory, SAML, SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect and web protocols like XML, SOAP, JSON, and REST.

Familiarity with access control models such as RBAC, ABAC and ReBAC.

Experience with SQL.

Practical experience developing and improving applications written in Node.js.

Exhibit excellent problem-solving abilities and effective communication skills, especially when collaborating with diverse teams.

Benefits:

Competitive compensation package, including equity.

Inclusive Healthcare Package.

Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

Flexible Time Off.

We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $196,000-$294,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

sources.text:
Source: Jobicy
Original listing: https://jobicy.com/jobs/153029-software-engineer-iii-ai-ml
Captured: 2026-10-15T23:45:32.837Z
Published: 2026-10-12T02:40:09.000Z

At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

ExtraHop is at the forefront of innovation in the cybersecurity space, delivering cutting-edge Network Detection and Response (NDR) solutions that empower organizations to detect, respond to, and mitigate cyber risks in real time.

Join ExtraHop as a Software Engineer III and help us build a fault-resilient, highly available, and customer-centric platform. In this role you will work as part of a collaborative engineering team to build a scalable and secure platform and deliver customer-facing AI/ML features that enable security teams to stop threats in their tracks. This is a rewarding opportunity for an engineer who is obsessed with customer success, passionate about building reliable software, and learning new technologies that contribute to AI/ML-powered security capabilities in the RevealX platform."

Our services and features are written primarily in Python, Golang, TypeScript, and React, with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and type-first design. Our team develops public REST APIs, solves database scalability challenges, implements data migrations, and enables configuration management across our fleet of services. The R(x) 360 Platform is built on AWS and GCP and utilizes Terraform to define Infrastructure-as-Code across our services and high-throughput data pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, test, and maintain software components that support AI/ML models, agentic processes, and data pipelines.

Contribute to the monitoring, evaluation, and improvement of algorithms used in behavioral detectors.

Participate in agile development processes, code reviews, and technical discussions.

Collaborate with senior engineers, data scientists, and threat researchers to integrate AI/ML features into the broader product architecture.

Implement well-scoped features and technical improvements with limited guidance from senior team members.

Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to engineering standards and best practices.

Help identify and address technical debt to continually improve our codebase and technical stack.

Stay current on the latest cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies to contribute to product enhancements.

Assist in the documentation of product features, technical specifications, and engineering guides.

Support a culture of curiosity, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

4+ years of professional software development experience, preferably in backend, cloud, or security related systems.

Solid knowledge of Python, Go, or an equivalent programming language, with strong general programming fundamentals.

Familiarity with building distributed, highly available cloud based systems, preferably on AWS.

Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile development practices.

Familiarity with containerization technologies (Kubernetes, Docker).

Strong problem-solving skills, a self-starter mentality, and the ability to take ownership and deliver well-defined technical tasks.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently with limited guidance in a fast-paced team environment.

Desire to grow in the intersection of software engineering, cybersecurity, and AI/Machine Learning

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with machine learning, statistics, actuarial modeling, or a related quantitative discipline.

Experience with cloud services on AWS or Azure (EKS / RDS / S3 / SQS / EC2 / IAM).

Experience with infrastructure as a software tooling, such as HashiCorp (Packer, Vault, Terraform).

Experience in API development, PostgreSQL database design, or SQL query performance optimization.

Familiarity with machine learning applications in cybersecurity or NDR environments.

Knowledge of tools and frameworks commonly used in network detection and response.

Understanding of threat detection, intrusion prevention, and incident response strategies.

The salary range for this role is $145,000 - $163,000 + bonus + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits

Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan

FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable

Educational Reimbursement

401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable

Pet Insurance (US Only)

Parental Leave (US Only)

Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer

sources.text:
Source: Jobicy
Original listing: https://jobicy.com/jobs/153066-lead-software-engineer
Captured: 2026-10-15T23:45:32.837Z
Published: 2026-10-12T02:35:22.000Z

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join our EMEA Engineering team in France (remote).

What does a Lead Software Engineer at CoderPad do?

As a Lead Software Engineer at CoderPad, you’ll design, build, and ship features across our full stack — taking ownership of complex technical problems end to end and raising the engineering bar for the EMEA team. You’ll combine hands-on coding with technical leadership: driving architecture decisions, backlog grooming and planning with the Product Manager, making sure what we ship is reliable, scalable, and a pleasure for developers to use.

As the global leader in the technical interview space (4,000+ customers in 165+ countries) it is our goal as a Engineering team to build and scale the products that power millions of technical interviews and assessments worldwide.

This role is located in France and works standard CET / CEST hours, collaborating asynchronously with our distributed EMEA and US teams.

What you’ll be doing

Design and develop new full-stack features (React / TypeScript on the frontend, Java, Node.js, or Ruby on the backend) in collaboration with the Product Manager and the designer.

Use AI coding assistants and agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as a core part of your workflow — to accelerate feature delivery, automate repetitive engineering tasks, and offload boilerplate so you can focus on design and review.

Contribute to architectural and technical design decisions within the team.

Write automated tests and ensure code quality through code reviews.

Deploy and monitor your own features in production (GitLab, AWS, Kubernetes).

Contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

Partner with Product and other teams to scope, prioritise, and deliver impactful work.

What you should bring

6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including senior or lead-level ownership

Proficiency in at least one backend language (Java, Ruby, Node.js), a modern frontend framework (ideally React), and SQL. You don’t need to master all technologies from day one.

Solid experience designing scalable, reliable systems and conducting thorough code reviews.

Comfortable working autonomously in a distributed, remote-first environment.

Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to ship faster — code generation, agentic workflows, scripting/automation, or building internal tooling on top of LLMs. We care about how effectively you use these tools, not which ones.

Professional working proficiency in English.

Compensation

Compensation Statement

Compensation for this role is base salary only (no variable component).

Base salary range (in EUR): €65,000 – €75,000

Exact salary is based on skills, experience, location, market ranges, and other compensation offered. The salary range does not include equity and company-wide benefits you may be eligible to receive.

Additional Information
